name: Luberon

limits: For white wine, Ugni Blanc: at most 50%
For white wine, Viognier: at most 10%
For red and rosé wine, Grenache and Syrah together: at least 60%
For red and rosé wine, Syrah: at least 20%
For red and rosé wine, Cinsault: at most 30%
For red and rosé wine, Carignan: at most 20%
For red and rosé wine, Counoise: at most 20%
For red and rosé wine, Marselan: at most 10%
For red wine, white grapes together: at most 10%
For rosé wine, white grapes together: at most 30%
For rosé wine, Viognier: at most 10%
rules.yield_base: 60 hl/ha for white, 55 for rosé and red

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation at the southeastern edge of the region, in Provence.
